caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement of several abstract and geometric shapes in red, gold, and turquoise blue set against a textured beige background. At the top, there is a stylized cross outlined in red with interior turquoise and gold details, backed by short gold rays. Below the cross is a bow-like shape with four rounded, elongated loops, each outlined in turquoise with red and gold dotted centers, converging at a small circular center marked with a turquoise X. To each side of the bow are gold wing-like shapes with three rounded feathers edged in red. The lower portion of the drawing is dominated by a large circular mandala design. The central circle is gold and turquoise, surrounded by a recurring petal pattern in gold, red, and turquoise with a combination of pointed and teardrop shapes, all enclosed in a red-bordered circle. The objects and shapes are evenly distributed and aligned vertically along the central axis of the image.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
